_comment: Game-specific tests for towerdef3d. Tier 2.6s scenarios.

scenarios.name: clock_advance_works
scenarios._: After 50 ticks: wave_timer was 3.0, ticked down to <0 at t31, wave_advance fired (wave 0→1, enemies_to_spawn=3, wave_timer=8). Then 19 more ticks of decrement: 8 - 1.9 ≈ 6.1.

scenarios.name: wave_progression_after_long_run
scenarios._: After 244 ticks (~24s), verify activity has happened: gold > 100 (kills granted gold) AND base took damage (enemies leaked) — ONE of these proves cascade integrity even though waves may not have fully advanced (depends on tower coverage vs path leakage).

scenarios.name: first_wave_starts
scenarios._: After 4s (40 ticks @ 0.1s tick), wave_clock should have enemies_to_spawn > 0 (set by wave_start rule when wave_timer ≤ 0). Initial wave_timer = 3.0.

scenarios.name: enemy_advances_at_waypoint
scenarios._: Place enemy near wp_2 with eastward velocity. After contact (radius 0.8), velocity_set should swap to wp_2's stored next_v (0, 0, 2 — turn south). wp_2 is at (-3, 0, -7).

scenarios.name: tower_fires_when_enemy_in_range
scenarios._: Place enemy 3m from tower_a at (-6, 0, -4) — range 6. After 5 ticks, tower has fired and enemy took at least 1 damage.

scenarios.name: enemy_takes_damage_from_projectile
scenarios._: Place a projectile right next to an enemy (radius 0.6). After 2 ticks, projectile gone, enemy.hp reduced. Set tower cooldown high so towers don't auto-fire and contaminate the projectile count.

scenarios.name: enemy_at_base_damages_it
scenarios._: Place enemy 0.3m from base at (9, 0, 0). Contact (radius 0.8) should fire: -1 base.hp, enemy removed.

scenarios.name: enemy_death_grants_gold
scenarios._: Manually zero an enemy's HP. enemy_death rule should fire (tick interval 1) → +5 gold, remove enemy.
